inventoryBasis: Original PNGs opened separately before reading any previous inventory or output.

groups.description: One circular tube envelope on the left. An upper short dark electrode has a vertical stem continuing through the top of the envelope. A broken horizontal electrode-like stroke crosses the middle toward the right. Two curved lower strokes and two downward open-ended leads are visible. These contours are not assignments of tube pin names.
unresolved: Exact connection of the curved lower electrode contours to the right-side descending conductor.
Whether individual thick stroke contacts inside the envelope are electrical joins.
No polarity or pin aliases are justified by these pixels alone.

groups.description: A vertically drawn winding immediately right of the tube, with repeated lobes and a horizontal upper approach from the tube's right-side middle stroke. Its lower approach bends left toward the descending conductor near the lower right of the tube.

labels.appearance: Italic L followed by a small c-shaped character beside/after it, above the left winding.
labels.identity: UNRESOLVED: Latin c versus Cyrillic small es; do not normalize to L_c or certify L_с from shape alone.

unresolved: Exact upper coil terminal join at the tube-envelope boundary.
Exact lower coil terminal join at the descending tube-side conductor.
Turn count is not a numerical given and is not certified.

groups.description: A second vertical winding is adjacent to, but visually separated from, the left winding. Its top approaches a horizontal conductor extending right; its bottom approaches another horizontal conductor extending right. The rightmost branch descends from the upper conductor to one capacitor plate, resumes below the other plate, and returns to the lower conductor.

labels.appearance: Italic L next to the right winding.
C left of the right-side capacitor plates.

unresolved: Thick winding-to-bus contacts require source review before declaring a circuit netlist.
The lower bus near the supply return has a small open/loop-like stroke; its junction semantics are not resolved.
No dot convention, winding polarity, capacitor sign, value, unit, or exact turn count is supplied.

groups.description: The tube's upper stem rises to a horizontal wire above the envelope and coils, runs right, then descends to the upper bus of the right-hand winding/capacitor group.
unresolved: The dark bus contact is observed as a contour; terminal/pin semantics are not certified.

groups.description: A conductor descends on the left from the tube-side lower junction, runs right toward a dark unequal-plate-like mark group, continues as a broken/dashed horizontal stroke, reaches a second dark plate-like mark group, then continues right and rises to the right-hand lower bus.
unresolved: Two separated visible mark groups are not an assertion of two cells or a source count.
Dashed continuation does not establish a number of omitted cells.
Do not invent battery voltage or polarity, signs, grounding, or source count.

figures.subfigures: One integrated circuit drawing; no lettered subparts.
figures.hold: Missing modern output: exact coil-label identity and several electrically meaningful coil/tube/bus joins remain unresolved. No simplified circuit, raw-SVG substitution, or asserted netlist is produced.

groups.description: Left rectangular block, approximately x16..301/y141..269, containing the Chinese label meaning Energy source.
Middle rectangular block, approximately x400..687/y142..273, containing the Chinese label meaning Device regulating energy input.
Right rectangular block, approximately x785..1062/y143..275, containing the Chinese label meaning Oscillating system.
Two right-pointing arrows: left block right edge to middle block left edge around y204; middle block right edge to right block left edge around y208. No fourth block exists.

One feedback path leaves the top of the right block near x912, rises to y63, runs left to approximately x545, then descends with an arrowhead into the top of the middle block near y142. Chinese Feedback label is above the horizontal return. This is a signal/control return, not an energy-supply bypass.

modernAdditions: English translations replace all four Chinese labels.
Labels wrap across lines so every label remains at least 16 CSS px at 331, 342 and 640 px media width.
Rectangles, spacing and line thickness are regularized; coordinates are layout decisions, not source numerical givens.
Semantic accent distinguishes the feedback signal path from the forward energy path without adding blocks or arrows.
No numerical values, phase signs, gain, device pin aliases, LC labels or guarantees of self-excitation are added.
